SessionStart.command: export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; CL_CMD=""; if [ -x ".codeledger/bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="./.codeledger/bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f ".codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node .codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif command -v codeledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then CL_CMD="codeledger"; elif [ -x "node_modules/.bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="node_modules/.bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/dist/index.js" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/dist/index.js"; fi; if [ -z "$CL_CMD" ]; then   echo "CodeLedger: CLI not found — install via npm or build from source."; else   CL_SID=$($CL_CMD session-init --quiet 2>/dev/null) || true;   if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then     export CODELEDGER_SESSION="$CL_SID";     $CL_CMD ensure-session --quiet --stale-after 3600 --session "$CL_SID";   else     $CL_CMD ensure-session --quiet --stale-after 3600;   fi; fi

UserPromptSubmit.command: export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; CL_CMD=""; if [ -x ".codeledger/bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="./.codeledger/bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f ".codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node .codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif command -v codeledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then CL_CMD="codeledger"; elif [ -x "node_modules/.bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="node_modules/.bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/dist/index.js" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/dist/index.js"; fi; if [ -z "$CL_CMD" ]; then exit 0; fi; $CL_CMD hooks claude user-prompt-submit --mode "${CODELEDGER_ACTIVATION_ENFORCEMENT:-warn}" 2>/dev/null || true;

PreToolUse.command: export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; CL_CMD=""; if [ -x ".codeledger/bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="./.codeledger/bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f ".codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node .codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif command -v codeledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then CL_CMD="codeledger"; elif [ -x "node_modules/.bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="node_modules/.bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/dist/index.js" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/dist/index.js"; fi; if [ -z "$CL_CMD" ]; then exit 0; fi; $CL_CMD hooks claude pre-tool-use --mode "${CODELEDGER_ACTIVATION_ENFORCEMENT:-warn}";

PostToolUse.command: export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "Bash" ] && echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then   CL_SID="${CODELEDGER_SESSION:-}";   if [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -n "$$" ]; then     CL_MARKER=".codeledger/.current-session-pid-$PPID";     [ -f "$CL_MARKER" ] && CL_SID=$(cat "$CL_MARKER" 2>/dev/null);     [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -f ".codeledger/.current-session-id" ] && CL_SID=$(cat ".codeledger/.current-session-id" 2>/dev/null);   fi; CL_CMD=""; if [ -x ".codeledger/bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="./.codeledger/bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f ".codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node .codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif command -v codeledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then CL_CMD="codeledger"; elif [ -x "node_modules/.bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="node_modules/.bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/dist/index.js" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/dist/index.js"; fi;   if [ -n "$CL_CMD" ]; then     if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then       $CL_CMD session-summary --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;       $CL_CMD value receipt --latest --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;     else       $CL_CMD session-summary 2>/dev/null || true;       $CL_CMD value receipt --latest 2>/dev/null || true;     fi;   fi; fi

export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "Read" ]; then   CL_SID="${CODELEDGER_SESSION:-}";   if [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -n "$$" ]; then     CL_MARKER=".codeledger/.current-session-pid-$PPID";     [ -f "$CL_MARKER" ] && CL_SID=$(cat "$CL_MARKER" 2>/dev/null);     [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -f ".codeledger/.current-session-id" ] && CL_SID=$(cat ".codeledger/.current-session-id" 2>/dev/null);   fi;   if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then     LOGDIR=".codeledger/sessions/$CL_SID";   else     LOGDIR=".codeledger";   fi;   LOGFILE="$LOGDIR/.read-log.jsonl";   NUDGE_MARKER="$LOGDIR/.last-nudge-count";   NUDGE_INTERVAL=10;   mkdir -p "$LOGDIR";   READ_PATH=$(node -e 'try { const input = JSON.parse(process.env.TOOL_INPUT || "{}"); if (typeof input.file_path === "string") process.stdout.write(input.file_path); } catch {}' 2>/dev/null || true);   if [ -n "$READ_PATH" ]; then     REL_PATH=$(echo "$READ_PATH" | sed "s|^$(pwd)/||");     node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const out = process.argv[1]; const sessionId = process.argv[2] || null; const filePath = process.argv[3]; fs.appendFileSync(out, JSON.stringify({ schema_version: "codeledger/tool-event/v1", event_type: "file.read", timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), session_id: sessionId, path: filePath }) + "\n");' "$LOGFILE" "$CL_SID" "$REL_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true;   fi;   if [ -f "$LOGFILE" ]; then     TOTAL=$(wc -l < "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ");     LAST_NUDGE=$(cat "$NUDGE_MARKER" 2>/dev/null || echo 0);     SINCE=$((TOTAL - LAST_NUDGE));     if [ "$SINCE" -ge "$NUDGE_INTERVAL" ]; then       echo "$TOTAL" > "$NUDGE_MARKER";       echo "CodeLedger: $TOTAL files read this session. Run codeledger progress-check to see bundle coverage, or codeledger refine --learned \"...\" to re-score.";     fi;   fi; fi

export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "Edit" ] || [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "Write" ]; then   CL_SID="${CODELEDGER_SESSION:-}";   if [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -n "$$" ]; then     CL_MARKER=".codeledger/.current-session-pid-$PPID";     [ -f "$CL_MARKER" ] && CL_SID=$(cat "$CL_MARKER" 2>/dev/null);     [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -f ".codeledger/.current-session-id" ] && CL_SID=$(cat ".codeledger/.current-session-id" 2>/dev/null);   fi;   if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then     BUNDLE=".codeledger/sessions/$CL_SID/active-bundle.md";     DRIFT_FILE=".codeledger/sessions/$CL_SID/.out-of-bundle-edits";   else     BUNDLE=".codeledger/active-bundle.md";     DRIFT_FILE=".codeledger/.out-of-bundle-edits";   fi;   EDIT_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"file_path":"//;s/"//g' 2>/dev/null || echo "");   if [ -n "$EDIT_PATH" ] && [ -f "$BUNDLE" ]; then     REL_PATH=$(echo "$EDIT_PATH" | sed "s|^$(pwd)/||");     if ! grep -qF "$REL_PATH" "$BUNDLE" 2>/dev/null; then       mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DRIFT_FILE")";       echo "$REL_PATH" >> "$DRIFT_FILE";       OOB_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$DRIFT_FILE" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ");       if [ "$OOB_COUNT" = "1" ]; then         CL_TASK=$(grep -m1 "^Task:" "$BUNDLE" 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^Task: *//" | head -c 80 || echo "");         if [ -n "$CL_TASK" ]; then           echo "CodeLedger: ⚠ editing outside predicted scope — $REL_PATH not in bundle";           echo "  → activated for: \"$CL_TASK\" · run: codeledger activate --task \"...\" to expand";         else           echo "CodeLedger: ⚠ editing outside predicted scope — $REL_PATH not in bundle";           echo "  → run: codeledger activate --task \"...\" to expand context";         fi;       fi;       NUDGE_AT=5;       if [ "$OOB_COUNT" = "$NUDGE_AT" ]; then         echo "CodeLedger: $OOB_COUNT edits outside the bundle. Consider refreshing: codeledger activate --task \"your current task\"";         if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then           rm -f ".codeledger/sessions/$CL_SID/.hook-reminded";         else           rm -f ".codeledger/.hook-reminded";         fi;       fi;     fi;   fi; fi

PreCompact.command: export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; CL_SID="${CODELEDGER_SESSION:-}"; if [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -n "$$" ]; then   CL_MARKER=".codeledger/.current-session-pid-$PPID";   [ -f "$CL_MARKER" ] && CL_SID=$(cat "$CL_MARKER" 2>/dev/null);   [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -f ".codeledger/.current-session-id" ] && CL_SID=$(cat ".codeledger/.current-session-id" 2>/dev/null); fi; CL_CMD=""; if [ -x ".codeledger/bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="./.codeledger/bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f ".codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node .codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif command -v codeledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then CL_CMD="codeledger"; elif [ -x "node_modules/.bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="node_modules/.bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/dist/index.js" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/dist/index.js"; fi; if [ -n "$CL_CMD" ]; then   if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then     $CL_CMD hooks claude pre-compact --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;     $CL_CMD session-progress --quiet --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;     echo "CodeLedger: session progress and bounded brief written under .codeledger/sessions/$CL_SID/ -- read them after compaction.";   else     $CL_CMD hooks claude pre-compact 2>/dev/null || true;     $CL_CMD session-progress --quiet 2>/dev/null || true;     echo "CodeLedger: session progress and bounded brief written under .codeledger/ -- read them after compaction.";   fi; fi

Stop.command: export CODELEDGER_HOOK_CONTEXT=claude_code; CL_SID="${CODELEDGER_SESSION:-}"; if [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -n "$$" ]; then   CL_MARKER=".codeledger/.current-session-pid-$PPID";   [ -f "$CL_MARKER" ] && CL_SID=$(cat "$CL_MARKER" 2>/dev/null);   [ -z "$CL_SID" ] && [ -f ".codeledger/.current-session-id" ] && CL_SID=$(cat ".codeledger/.current-session-id" 2>/dev/null); fi; CL_CMD=""; if [ -x ".codeledger/bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="./.codeledger/bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f ".codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node .codeledger/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/bin/codeledger-standalone.cjs"; elif command -v codeledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then CL_CMD="codeledger"; elif [ -x "node_modules/.bin/codeledger" ]; then CL_CMD="node_modules/.bin/codeledger"; elif [ -f "packages/cli/dist/index.js" ]; then CL_CMD="node packages/cli/dist/index.js"; fi; if [ -n "$CL_CMD" ]; then   if [ -n "$CL_SID" ]; then     $CL_CMD hooks claude stop --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;     $CL_CMD session-summary --final --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;     $CL_CMD session-cleanup --session "$CL_SID" 2>/dev/null || true;   else     $CL_CMD hooks claude stop 2>/dev/null || true;     $CL_CMD session-summary --final 2>/dev/null || true;     rm -f .codeledger/.hook-reminded .codeledger/.session-start-ref .codeledger/.activate-ref .codeledger/.task-activated .codeledger/session-progress.md;   fi; fi; echo "Tip: Run codeledger activate --task \"your next task\" to refresh context for the next task."
